items.detail: **Wednesday's October PCE inflation** is the main event, with **core PCE** expected to rise to 3.2% from 3.1%. Q3 GDP and the Fed's Beige Book come out the same day.
items.why: It is the last inflation reading before the December Fed meeting, so a hot print would firm up bets on a rate hike.

items.detail: **Dell** reports after the close on **Tuesday**, with analysts expecting about **$6.63 a share** in earnings. Workday and HP also report this week.
items.why: Dell's AI-server orders are the week's main test of whether AI demand still justifies Nasdaq prices after the chip rout.

items.detail: The **S&P 500** starts the week in a correction at **6,910**. US markets are shut Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early, at 1 p.m., on Friday.
items.why: With fewer traders around, a surprise in Wednesday's data could cause outsized swings in either direction.

items.detail: The **Bank of Korea** decides rates on **Thursday**, and most analysts expect a hike to **3.25%** from 3%. The MSCI EM index starts the week in a bear market.
items.why: A hike while Korean chip stocks are falling could push more money out of Asia unless the dollar eases.

items.detail: India has a short week. Indian markets are closed **Tuesday** for Guru Nanak Jayanti, and the monthly F&O expiry was moved to Monday. The Nifty is just below **26,000**.
items.why: Record November foreign buying drove the rally, so any sign of foreign funds pulling out would hit banks first.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** starts the week at **2,581.79** with Wednesday's PCE ahead. In India, smallcaps have been slipping while large caps rally.
items.why: Smaller US firms carry far more floating-rate debt, so a firmer December hike would raise their borrowing costs quickly.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** starts the week near **$60,000** after briefly hitting about $55,000 on Saturday. US spot bitcoin ETFs have lost about $3.5 billion in November.
items.why: Unless ETF selling slows, a hot PCE print on Wednesday could send bitcoin back toward its weekend low.

items.detail: **Ether** starts the week near **$1,740**, and US ether ETFs have had eight straight weeks of outflows.
items.why: No scheduled upgrade is coming to help, so ether depends on ETF flows and Wednesday's inflation data.

items.detail: **Solana** starts the week near **$68.68**, below $70. Its ETFs took in small amounts of money last week while bitcoin and ether funds lost money.
items.why: If that ETF buying holds through the PCE print, it could support Solana better than its peers in a weak market.

items.detail: **Gold** starts the week near **$3,544** an ounce, and Wednesday's PCE and GDP data are its biggest test.
items.why: A hot print would firm bets on a December hike and lift the dollar, which tends to push gold down.

crossCuttingTheme: Wednesday's US PCE inflation report, the last before the December Fed meeting, decides whether rate-hike bets and near-5% Treasury yields keep climbing, and with them the dollar pressure on tech, EM, crypto and gold.
